en: Hi there, {player}! How did things go with Skyla? Oh? You haven't won her Badge yet?
Then I'll keep up my field work a little longer. Before you go, take this for your trip.
Give that Lucky Egg to a Pokémon to hold, and it earns a little more Experience from every battle! Strong Pokémon make a strong Trainer.
The Celestial Tower... a giant memorial. I wonder whether it was built where Ghost and Psychic Pokémon gathered, or whether they came because of it.
Either way it's fascinating. Come and fetch me when you've beaten Skyla!
Oh, that's right! How did things go with Skyla? You won the Jet Badge! Well done!
Do take that Lucky Egg. Held by a Pokémon, it earns a little more Experience from every battle.
Then the plane should be ready to fly! Thank you for coming to fetch me.
I'll be waiting for you in Mistralton City!
